guarantee: If the post-normalize, post-trim message matches NON_FIREWALL_PREFIX (/i, no /u; start-anchored CLASSIFY_SPEC daemon name followed by end or a code unit outside ASCII alnum, underscore, and hyphen), isFirewallEvent returns false and the line is excluded from the firewall-event set before evaluateClassifySpec. A non-match does not mean the line is a firewall event. This record does not claim raw-log correspondence, DOM safety, shell engine equivalence, or as-written Unicode case-folding, and it does not register a harness property.
input_source: logd records from ubus log.read in rpcd fetch_firewall_logs; the haystack is entry.msg after normalizeNetfilterMessage (one ASCII space before a glued CLASSIFY_SPEC glue key) and classifyTrim (strip space, tab, LF, CR, NBSP). LuCI sessions never receive log.read. The prefix vocabulary is trusted CLASSIFY_SPEC; the string is not.
declared_domain: Finite JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit sequences supplied to the guard, including NUL and isolated surrogates. Empty msg is a separate early-return, not this regex. No ASCII-only or length restriction exists at this consumer. Shell awk non_fw_prefix is a generated parity mirror, not the theorem domain.
